_note: publication-required-at-publish REQ-PRP-001 (design D1): a draft declares no rule, so it may stay incomplete (OpenRegister refuses an empty required list); from in_review on a publication must carry a summary, a description and the organisation it names. No groups key, so the rule holds for everyone. A publication published before the rule existed is answered with OpenRegister's @notSupplied record under the one reason administered here, written by the upgrade repair steps when they re-save it (RequiredToPublish::recordGaps), so the upgrade can save it and the gap stays visible instead of being filled with invented text (design D2). The schema version bump lives in woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json, which sorts last and so wins the scalar merge.

x-openregister-not-supplied-reasons.published-before-required: Published before this field was required to publish
